(b) $SE \approx 0.05.$ (c) $H_0: p_{new} - p_{std} = 0,$ $H_A: p_{new} - p_{std} < 0$; p-value $< 0.001$ (none of the 1,000 shuffled differences came near $-0.416$); reject $H_0$ — the new protocol lowers the flag rate, and the claim is causal because protocols were randomized.
